svg.title: The main skill: take a step of the job and ask whether an AI, a short piece of code or a tool can do it. If yes, build it. If no, ask how a person would do it, split it into smaller steps, and ask again for each smaller step.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Keep splitting until every step is buildable
